title: Sorting by Avg Cost ignores whether parts are tracked
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Four parts at {Location-A} have numbers starting {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SORTC-), each with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SORTC-01, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SORTC ALPHA) is tracked with Avg Cost $7.00.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SORTC-02, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SORTC BRAVO) is untracked with Avg Cost $9.00.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SORTC-03, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SORTC DELTA) is untracked with Avg Cost $3.00.
  • Inventory part {Part-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SORTC-04, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SORTC ECHO) is tracked with Avg Cost $9.00.
  • {Prefix-A} is typed in the Inventory search.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Avg Cost column header once.
  2. Read the four rows from top to bottom.
  3. Click the Avg Cost header again.
  4. Read the four rows from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Order: {Part-C} ($3.00, untracked), {Part-A} ($7.00), {Part-B} ($9.00, untracked), {Part-D} ($9.00). Cost decides first; {Part-B} (BRAVO) and {Part-D} (ECHO) share $9.00 and are ordered by description A to Z; the untracked {Part-C} comes first and is not pushed below the tracked parts.
  • Step 4: Order: {Part-B} ($9.00, untracked), {Part-D} ($9.00), {Part-A} ($7.00), {Part-C} ($3.00, untracked). The untracked {Part-B} is at the top; the $9.00 pair is still {Part-B} before {Part-D}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S6-R8, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.0 (today's Inventory list, "Avg Cost" header), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Story SV-10819 acceptance criterion (sorted by Average Cost: cost first, description second) agrees; the list's header reads "Avg Cost" (Product answer of 9 Oct 2026, question 3, and the 7 Oct planning comment). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R8: “Sorting by any other column sorts by that column first, then by description, A to Z. Tracking state plays no part in it.”
  • SV-10819 acceptance criteria: “Given the list is sorted by Average Cost, when it loads, then it is ordered by cost first and description second, with tracking state playing no part.”
